capabilities: Handwrite and highlight on PDFs with pen, highlighter, eraser and ruler
Export annotated PDF copies while keeping the original intact
Create handwritten notebooks on blank, grid or dotted paper
Search and favorite notebooks in a Moye library
Export notebooks as PDF and recover copies from local backups
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown note-taking app; it adds handwriting notebooks and PDF annotation on top of an existing vault.
extras: Free edition works offline with no account or telemetry; Pro is a separate paid edition adding Markdown annotation, OCR, handwriting beautification and AI Q&A. Requires Obsidian 1.15.1 or later, and iOS/iPadOS 18 or later for PDF rendering on iPhone and iPad. Proprietary software; the Free build source is in a private repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite on PDFs or keep pen-and-paper style notebooks, so annotated reading and handwritten notes end up outside the vault.

relations.evidence: 另行安装兼容的墨词 InkLex Pro 后，可扩展 PDF 阅读与词汇学习体验

requires.name: AI service for Pro AI Q&A

summary: Handwriting and PDF annotation tool that marks up PDFs, exports annotated copies, and keeps handwritten notebooks inside the vault.
